title: Sources & further reading
body:
Primary/official sources checked directly for this guide: Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026 official announcement · Japan MOFA — visa exemption · Japan Tourism Agency — tax-free system change, Nov 1 2026 · Japan Customs — tax-free FAQ · JR Kyushu Rail Pass · JR East — Suica/PASMO sales status · Seven Bank — foreign-card ATM access · JNTO — Matsushima · JNTO — Jigokudani, Noboribetsu · Visit Miyagi — Naruko Gorge · JR Hokkaido — scenic tour trains · Shin Shin ramen, Tenjin · Ganso Nagahamaya · Ganso Motsunabe Rakutenchi · Fukuya mentaiko, Nakasu · Kisuimaru, Hakata Station · Animate Fukuoka · Mandarake Fukuoka · Animate Sapporo · Mandarake Sapporo · Animate Sendai · jozankei.jp — official autumn hiking trails · Zao Town tourism association · Ubigi Japan eSIM rates.

Secondary/community leads (used to find the above, never cited as fact on their own): Fukuoka Now (resident magazine), Yahoo Chiebukuro local Q&A threads, Visit Miyagi and Tohoku Kanko regional tourism sites, japan-guide.com, and assorted r/JapanTravel-adjacent forum/blog discussion — direct Reddit access was blocked, so forum leads came via search-indexed snippets rather than full threads.

Every fact above carries its own source and checked date inline in the section it appears in — this list is a jumping-off point for your own pre-trip re-checks, not a substitute for the per-section citations.
